basic_info.description: The Apex of fine living is here on Arch Street! This spacious 1275 sqft of living is perfectly placed on a 2495 sqft lot in one of the best locations in San Francisco! Beautiful built-ins and hardwood flooring throughout sets the tone of warmth and calling for you to make this house your home! Meticulously maintained and loved by the same family for nearly 50 years... This is a rare opportunity to acquire a dynasty home for you and generations to come! Let's not forget about the full basement with additional bonus room down that gives flexibility to this already incredible floor plan. The spacious yard is a blank canvas for you to create your ideal living space. The photos look incredible and they don't even do it justice... Make sure to put this stunner at the top of your must see list! Easy access to Highway 280 and the Peninsula!
